book: BC exam drugs · EMR vs PCP
title: New PCP drugs: breathing, steroids and TXA
next: Chapter 1: EMS Systems, Roles, and Responsibilities

slides.title: Today's lesson
slides.body:
As an EMR you already give salbutamol, oxygen and IM epinephrine, control bleeding and keep shocked patients warm. Today, as a PCP:

  1. Add ipratropium to salbutamol: why, how much, how often
  2. Use dexamethasone: a slow steroid for asthma, COPD and croup
  3. Give TXA in the hypovolemia protocol, and know its hard stops

BC source: drug monographs pages 62, 70, 78; protocols pages 27, 32, 34, 49, 54
slides.say: Welcome back. This is the last of the new PCP drugs. As an EMR, you already give salbutamol and oxygen to a wheezing patient and intramuscular epinephrine for anaphylaxis, and you control bleeding and keep a shocked patient warm. Today we add three drugs that build on exactly those skills. First, ipratropium, which works alongside salbutamol. Second, dexamethasone, a steroid that treats airway inflammation slowly. And third, TXA, or tranexamic acid, which helps a clot hold in a bleeding trauma patient. For each one, we'll see how it fits with what you already do.
slides.sayZh: 欢迎回来。这是 PCP 新药的最后一课。当 EMR 时，你已经会给喘鸣病人沙丁胺醇和氧气、给过敏性休克病人肌注肾上腺素，也会止血、给休克病人保暖。今天加三种药，正好建立在这些技能之上。第一，异丙托溴铵，和沙丁胺醇搭配使用。第二，地塞米松，一种慢慢消除气道炎症的激素。第三，TXA（氨甲环酸），帮助出血的创伤病人把血凝块稳住。每种药我们都看看它怎么和你已经在做的事配合。

slides.title: Two ways to open the airways
slides.body:
Salbutamolβ2 stimulation relaxes airway muscleonset 5 min; may repeat
Ipratropiumblocks acetylcholine, which tightens airway muscleonset 3–15 min; single dose
Dexamethasonecalms airway inflammationonset minutes to hours

Ipratropium is not for acute bronchospasm on its own: it works with salbutamol.
slides.say: Think of the muscle around the airways as having two controls. Salbutamol presses the relax button: it stimulates beta-two receptors, and the muscle lets go. Ipratropium removes a tighten signal: it blocks acetylcholine, a nerve messenger that makes the airway muscle squeeze. The two together work better than either alone. That's why BC says ipratropium is meant to work together with salbutamol, and not to treat acute bronchospasm by itself. Dexamethasone is different again. It doesn't open the airways right now. It calms the inflammation, the swelling and leaking inside the airway walls, and that takes minutes to hours. Three drugs, three speeds.
slides.sayZh: 把气道周围的肌肉想成有两个开关。沙丁胺醇按的是「放松」键：刺激 β2 受体，肌肉就松开。异丙托溴铵拿掉的是「收紧」信号：它阻断乙酰胆碱，这种神经递质会让气道肌肉收缩。两者合用比单用任何一个都好，所以 BC 说异丙托溴铵是要和沙丁胺醇协同作用的，不能单独用来处理急性支气管痉挛。地塞米松又不一样：它不会马上打开气道，而是让气道壁里的炎症、肿胀和渗漏平息下来，需要几分钟到几小时。三种药，三种速度。

slides.title: Ipratropium: the BC doses
slides.body:
NebulizerMDI
Adult500 mcg160 mcg (8 × 20 mcg)
Child (PCP: severe bronchospasm in asthma)250 mcg (½ nebule)80 mcg (4 × 20 mcg)
  • For severe bronchospasm in asthma and COPD
  • Same nebulizer as salbutamol; ipratropium once, salbutamol may repeat
  • Not for neonates under 30 days
  • Only contraindication: allergy to the drug or its ingredients
slides.say: Here are the BC doses. Ipratropium is for severe bronchospasm in asthma and COPD. An adult gets five hundred micrograms by nebulizer, or one hundred sixty micrograms by inhaler, which is eight puffs of twenty. You can put it in the same nebulizer as salbutamol, but remember the rule: ipratropium is a single dose, while salbutamol may be repeated. For a child with severe asthma, the dose is half: two hundred fifty micrograms by nebulizer, which is half a nebule, or four puffs of twenty micrograms by inhaler. Never give it to a newborn under thirty days old. The only contraindication is allergy to the drug or its ingredients.
slides.sayZh: 这是 BC 剂量。异丙托溴铵用于哮喘和 COPD 的严重支气管痉挛。成人雾化五百微克，或吸入器一百六十微克，也就是每喷二十微克、共八喷。它可以和沙丁胺醇放在同一个雾化器里，但记住这条规则：异丙托溴铵只给一次，沙丁胺醇可以重复。严重哮喘的儿童剂量减半：雾化二百五十微克，也就是半支；或吸入器四喷、每喷二十微克。出生不满三十天的新生儿不能用。唯一的禁忌是对本药或其成分过敏。

slides.title: Asthma / COPD: EMR vs PCP
slides.body:
All licence levels (EMR + PCP)

  • Sit up, leaning forward; limit movement
  • O₂ toward SpO₂ ≥ 94% (may not be achievable)
  • Auscultate; history and vitals
  • Salbutamol neb or MDI; transport after first dose
  • Ventilated? MDI through the BVM side port

PCP adds

  • Salbutamol with ipratropium
  • Severe, or near respiratory failure → epinephrine IM
  • Consider dexamethasone
  • Consider CPAP
slides.say: Here's where these drugs live. The asthma and COPD protocol starts with what you know: sit the patient up and leaning forward, oxygen toward ninety-four percent, though it may not be reachable, listen to the chest, and give salbutamol by nebulizer or inhaler, transporting after the first dose. The PCP adds four tools. Salbutamol with ipratropium. Intramuscular epinephrine for severe disease or imminent respiratory failure, for example a saturation under ninety percent, or moderate to severe bronchospasm that salbutamol hasn't fixed. Dexamethasone. And CPAP, if the patient meets the CPAP criteria. Each one is written as "consider", so each one is your decision.
slides.sayZh: 这些药就在这个流程里。哮喘和 COPD 流程从你熟悉的开始：让病人坐直、身体前倾，给氧争取到百分之九十四，虽然不一定达得到；听诊；用雾化或吸入器给沙丁胺醇，给完第一剂就转运。PCP 加四样工具：沙丁胺醇加异丙托溴铵；严重病情或即将呼吸衰竭时肌注肾上腺素，比如血氧低于百分之九十，或用了沙丁胺醇后仍是中重度支气管痉挛；地塞米松；以及符合条件时用 CPAP。每一项都写的是「考虑」，所以每一项都由你决定。

slides.q: A 68-year-old with COPD is still wheezing badly after one salbutamol neb. SpO₂ 91% on O₂, alert. You are the PCP. What goes in your next nebulizer?
options: Salbutamol alone; ipratropium is for asthma only
slides.say: Time for a decision. A sixty-eight-year-old with COPD is still wheezing badly after one salbutamol nebulizer. Saturation ninety-one percent on oxygen, and he's alert. You're the PCP. What goes in your next nebulizer? A, ipratropium five hundred micrograms alone. B, salbutamol five milligrams with ipratropium five hundred micrograms. C, ipratropium two hundred fifty micrograms, the half dose. D, salbutamol alone, because ipratropium is for asthma only. Tap your answer.
slides.sayZh: 来做个决策。一位六十八岁 COPD 病人，用了一次沙丁胺醇雾化后仍喘得厉害，给氧下血氧百分之九十一，神志清醒。你是 PCP，下一次雾化放什么？A 单用异丙托溴铵五百微克；B 沙丁胺醇五毫克加异丙托溴铵五百微克；C 异丙托溴铵二百五十微克，半量；D 只用沙丁胺醇，因为异丙托溴铵只用于哮喘。点选你的答案。
slides.explain: The answer is B. Severe bronchospasm in COPD is an ipratropium indication, and BC allows salbutamol and ipratropium in the same nebulizer. A is wrong because ipratropium isn't meant to treat acute bronchospasm on its own. C is the child dose; an adult gets five hundred micrograms. D is wrong because the indication covers both asthma and COPD. And for the neb after that: salbutamol may repeat, but the ipratropium was a single dose.
slides.explainZh: 答案是 B。COPD 的严重支气管痉挛是异丙托溴铵的适应症，BC 允许沙丁胺醇和异丙托溴铵放在同一个雾化器里。A 错，异丙托溴铵不应单独用于急性支气管痉挛。C 是儿童剂量，成人是五百微克。D 错，适应症同时包括哮喘和 COPD。再下一次雾化时记住：沙丁胺醇可以重复，异丙托溴铵只给一次。

slides.title: Dexamethasone: the slow helper
slides.body:
• Steroid: less inflammation, less leaky capillaries
  • Adjunct for croup, and for bronchospasm from asthma or COPD
  • Onset minutes to hours; peak 1–2 h PO, 8 h IM
  • No: systemic fungal infection; allergy to any corticosteroid

It doesn't open the airway now: never instead of salbutamol or epinephrine.
slides.say: Dexamethasone is a corticosteroid, a steroid that fights inflammation. It slows white blood cells called neutrophils, reduces the chemicals that drive inflammation, and makes leaky capillaries less leaky. In BC it's an adjunct, an add-on, for two problems: croup, a swelling of the upper airway in young children, and bronchospasm from asthma or COPD. It works over minutes to hours: by mouth it peaks at one to two hours, by intramuscular injection at about eight. It's contraindicated with a systemic fungal infection or an allergy to any corticosteroid. The key idea: dexamethasone doesn't open the airway now, so it never replaces salbutamol or epinephrine.
slides.sayZh: 地塞米松是糖皮质激素，一种抗炎的激素。它让一种叫中性粒细胞的白细胞迁移变慢，减少推动炎症的化学物质，让渗漏的毛细血管不再那么漏。在 BC 它是辅助药，用于两种情况：哮吼，也就是幼儿的上气道肿胀；以及哮喘或 COPD 引起的支气管痉挛。它在几分钟到几小时内起效：口服一到两小时达峰，肌注大约八小时。全身性真菌感染、对任何糖皮质激素过敏都禁用。关键是：地塞米松不会马上打开气道，所以绝不能取代沙丁胺醇或肾上腺素。

slides.title: Dexamethasone: dose and cautions
slides.body:
Adult 8 mg · Child 0.5 mg/kg, max 16 mg

  • Routes listed: IV/IO/IM/PO; PO preferred (child: may mix with juice)
  • Heart failure or hypertension: fluid retention, electrolyte changes
  • Acute MI: steroids linked to myocardial rupture
  • Pregnancy: crosses the placenta
  • Young children: risk of hypercortisolism
  • Not for adrenal insufficiency (no mineralocorticoid effect)
slides.say: The BC dose is simple. An adult gets eight milligrams. A child gets zero point five milligrams per kilogram, up to a maximum of sixteen. So a twenty-kilogram child gets ten milligrams, but a forty-kilogram child stops at sixteen. The monograph lists IV, IO, IM and oral routes, and says by mouth is preferred; for a child you can mix it with juice to help the taste. The cautions: in heart failure or high blood pressure it can cause fluid retention; steroids have been linked to rupture of the heart wall after a heart attack; it crosses the placenta; it can cause too much cortisol in young children; and it isn't a treatment for adrenal insufficiency.
slides.sayZh: BC 剂量很简单：成人八毫克；儿童每公斤零点五毫克，最多十六毫克。所以二十公斤的孩子给十毫克，四十公斤的孩子到十六毫克就封顶。专论列出静脉、骨髓腔、肌注和口服四种途径，并写明首选口服；给孩子可以混在果汁里改善口味。注意事项：心衰或高血压病人可能出现水钠潴留；心梗急性期用激素与心脏破裂有关；它能通过胎盘；幼儿可能出现皮质醇过多；它也不能用来治疗肾上腺功能不全。

slides.title: Putting the breathing drugs together
slides.body:
Salbutamol (all levels)→+ ipratropium, once (PCP)→severe: epinephrine IM (PCP)
  • Dexamethasone: consider it; it needs hours to work
  • Still hypoxic despite bronchodilators, meets criteria → CPAP
  • Tiring, LOC falling → BVM, PEEP if indicated
  • Reassess and record SpO₂ after every step
slides.say: Let's put the breathing drugs together in the order the protocol lists them. Everyone starts with salbutamol. The PCP can add ipratropium, once, in the same nebulizer. If the disease is severe, with a saturation under ninety or bronchospasm that won't break, the PCP considers intramuscular epinephrine, and severity, not habit, decides how fast you get there. Dexamethasone fits alongside: consider it, knowing it needs hours. If the patient is still short of breath with a low saturation despite the bronchodilators, and meets the criteria, consider CPAP. If they tire out and their level of consciousness falls, ventilate with a bag-valve mask instead, with PEEP if indicated.
slides.sayZh: 按流程列出的顺序把呼吸用药串起来。所有人都从沙丁胺醇开始。PCP 可以在同一个雾化器里加一次异丙托溴铵。病情严重，比如血氧低于九十，或支气管痉挛怎么也缓解不了，PCP 就考虑肌注肾上腺素；多快走到这一步，由严重程度决定，不是由习惯决定。地塞米松同时考虑，但要知道它需要几小时。用了支气管扩张剂后仍气促、血氧低，且符合条件，就考虑 CPAP。如果病人累了、意识下降，就改用球囊面罩通气，有指征时加 PEEP。

slides.title: TXA: help the clot hold
slides.body:
Clot forms→body starts breaking it down→TXA blocks the breakdown
  • Antifibrinolytic: competes for tPA receptor sites
  • For major trauma after starting the hypovolemia protocol
  • Or shock with MOI or findings of occult or ongoing bleeding
  • Monograph "considerations": epistaxis, postpartum hemorrhage
  • It does not replace pressure, tourniquets or the pelvic binder
slides.say: TXA, or tranexamic acid, works on clots from a different angle. After an injury, the body builds a clot, but it also runs a clean-up process, called fibrinolysis, that breaks clots down. In major trauma, that breakdown works against you. TXA blocks it, so the clot holds. It doesn't build a clot, so it never replaces direct pressure, a tourniquet or a pelvic binder. BC lists two indications: major trauma after you've started the hypovolemia protocol, and signs of shock where the mechanism of injury or your exam suggests hidden or ongoing bleeding. The monograph also names nosebleeds and bleeding after childbirth as "considerations", without more detail.
slides.sayZh: TXA（氨甲环酸）从另一个角度作用于血凝块。受伤后身体会形成血凝块，但同时也在进行一种叫纤溶的清理过程，把血凝块分解掉。严重创伤时，这种分解对你不利。TXA 阻断它，血凝块就能稳住。它不会制造血凝块，所以永远不能取代直接压迫、止血带或骨盆带。BC 列出两个适应症：已启动低血容量流程的严重创伤；以及受伤机制或体检提示有隐匿或持续出血的休克体征。专论还把鼻出血和产后出血列为「考虑情况」，没有更多说明。

slides.title: TXA: dose and hard stops
slides.body:
2 g (2,000 mg) IV push over 1 minute

  • Allergy to TXA
  • More than 3 hours since the injury
  • Patient under 12 years
  • Isolated traumatic brain injury

Onset immediate. Pushed too fast → further hypotension.
slides.say: The BC dose is one number: two grams, which is two thousand milligrams, by IV push over one minute. It acts immediately. Pushing it faster than that can drop the blood pressure further, and your patient is already in shock, so watch the clock while you push. Then the four hard stops. No TXA with an allergy to it. No TXA more than three hours after the injury, so always find out when it happened. No TXA under twelve years old. And no TXA for an isolated traumatic brain injury, which means a head injury with no other injury.
slides.sayZh: BC 剂量只有一个数字：两克，也就是两千毫克，静脉推注，一分钟推完。它立即起效。推得比一分钟快会让血压进一步下降，而你的病人本来就在休克，所以推的时候要看着时间。然后是四个硬禁忌：对 TXA 过敏不给；受伤超过三小时不给，所以一定要问清楚什么时候受的伤；十二岁以下不给；单纯颅脑外伤不给，也就是只有头部受伤、没有其他损伤。

slides.q: A motorcyclist crashed 2 hours ago. Deformed femur, tender pelvis, HR 128, BP 82/50, GCS 15. You are the PCP, en route, IV running. What about TXA?
options: No: TXA is only for head injuries
Yes: 2 g IV push over 1 minute
Yes: 1 g over 10 minutes, then 1 g over 8 hours
No: it has been more than 1 hour
slides.say: Let's try a trauma decision. A motorcyclist crashed two hours ago. He has a deformed femur, a tender pelvis, a heart rate of one hundred twenty-eight, a blood pressure of eighty-two over fifty, and he's fully alert. You're the PCP, en route, with an IV running. What about TXA? A, no, TXA is only for head injuries. B, yes, two grams IV push over one minute. C, yes, one gram over ten minutes, then one gram over eight hours. D, no, it's been more than one hour. Tap your answer.
slides.sayZh: 来做一道创伤决策题。一位摩托车手两小时前出了车祸，股骨畸形，骨盆压痛，心率一百二十八，血压八十二比五十，神志完全清醒。你是 PCP，在转运途中，静脉已开通。TXA 怎么办？A 不给，TXA 只用于颅脑外伤；B 给，两克静推，一分钟推完；C 给，一克十分钟滴完，再一克八小时滴完；D 不给，已经超过一小时。点选你的答案。
slides.explain: The answer is B. He's in shock with likely hidden bleeding from the femur and pelvis, he's over twelve, and he's still inside the three-hour window, so the BC dose is two grams IV push over one minute. A is backwards: an isolated head injury is a contraindication. C is the textbook regimen, not the BC dose. D uses the wrong window: BC's limit is three hours, not one. And the pelvic binder and splints still come first.
slides.explainZh: 答案是 B。他处于休克，股骨和骨盆很可能有隐匿出血，年龄超过十二岁，仍在三小时窗口内，所以按 BC 剂量两克静推、一分钟推完。A 说反了：单纯颅脑外伤才是禁忌。C 是课本的方案，不是 BC 剂量。D 的时间窗错了：BC 的上限是三小时，不是一小时。另外，骨盆带和夹板仍然要先做。

slides.title: Hypovolemia: EMR vs PCP
slides.body:
For hypovolemia + systolic < 90 + other signs of shock, or burns > 20% BSA

All licence levels (EMR + PCP)

  • Control external hemorrhage
  • Splint pelvis / fractures if indicated
  • Supine to support blood pressure
  • Keep warm; prevent heat loss
  • O₂ to SpO₂ ≥ 94%

PCP adds (en route or time delay)

  • Obtain vascular access
  • Fluid bolus 20 mL/kg, max 2 L; reassess every 500 mL
  • Consider TXA: shock from blood loss, or occult bleeding
slides.say: TXA is part of a package, so here it is in the hypovolemia protocol. You use the protocol for low blood volume with a systolic under ninety and other signs of shock, or for burns over twenty percent. The left column is your EMR work: stop external bleeding, splint the pelvis and fractures, lay the patient flat, keep them warm, and give oxygen. The PCP column happens en route, or on scene only if there's a delay: an IV, a fluid bolus of twenty millilitres per kilogram up to two litres, reassessing every five hundred, and TXA for shock from blood loss or hidden bleeding. TXA and fluids support your bleeding control; they never replace it.
slides.sayZh: TXA 是一整套处理的一部分，这里把它放回低血容量流程里看。这个流程用于血容量不足、收缩压低于九十并有其他休克征象的病人，或烧伤面积超过百分之二十。左栏是你的 EMR 工作：控制外出血、固定骨盆和骨折、平卧、保暖、给氧。PCP 那一栏在转运途中做，只有现场有延误时才在现场做：开静脉，每公斤二十毫升推注、最多两升、每五百毫升复评，以及对失血性休克或隐匿出血使用 TXA。TXA 和补液是支持你的止血，永远不能取代止血。

slides.title: TXA across the trauma protocols
slides.body:
ProtocolTXA
Hypovolemiaconsider for shock from blood loss or occult bleeding
Abdominal injuriesen route, if indicated
Chest traumaen route, if indicated
Traumatic brain injurycontraindicated if the TBI is isolated

Isolated TBI = the head is the only injury. Before TXA, ask: shock from bleeding? under 3 h? age 12+?
slides.say: TXA shows up in four trauma protocols. In hypovolemia, you consider it for shock from blood loss or hidden bleeding. In abdominal injuries and chest trauma, it's on the PCP list en route, if indicated, along with vascular access. And in traumatic brain injury, it appears as a contraindication: no TXA for an isolated head injury, meaning the head is the only injury. So when you meet a bleeding trauma patient, ask three questions before TXA. Is there shock from bleeding? Is it less than three hours since the injury? And is the patient twelve or older?
slides.sayZh: TXA 出现在四个创伤流程里。低血容量流程：失血性休克或隐匿出血时考虑使用。腹部损伤和胸部创伤：在 PCP 那一栏，转运途中、有指征时使用，同时建立静脉通路。颅脑外伤流程里它是禁忌：单纯颅脑外伤不给 TXA，「单纯」就是只有头部受伤。所以遇到出血的创伤病人，给 TXA 之前问三个问题：是不是出血导致的休克？受伤是否不到三小时？病人是否年满十二岁？

slides.title: For the BC exam: book vs BC
slides.body:
• TXA, book: 1 g over 10 min, then 1 g over 8 hours
  • TXA, BC: 2 g IV push over 1 minute
  • BC TXA stops: over 3 h, under 12, isolated TBI
  • Dexamethasone adult: book 4–10 mg; BC 8 mg
  • Child dexamethasone: book 0.25–1 mg/kg; BC 0.5 mg/kg, max 16 mg
  • Child ipratropium: book 0.25–0.5 mg neb; BC 250 mcg
slides.say: Your textbook and BC differ on all three drugs, so be careful. For TXA, the book gives one gram over ten minutes, then another gram over eight hours. BC gives a single dose: two grams by IV push over one minute, and BC's stops are more than three hours, under twelve, and an isolated head injury. For dexamethasone, the book's adult range is four to ten milligrams, while BC gives eight. For children, the book says a quarter to one milligram per kilogram, while BC gives half a milligram per kilogram, up to sixteen. And for a child's ipratropium, the book allows up to half a milligram, while BC gives two hundred fifty micrograms.
slides.sayZh: 课本和 BC 在这三种药上都有差别，要小心。TXA：课本是一克十分钟滴完，再一克八小时滴完；BC 是单次两克静推、一分钟推完，BC 的禁忌是超过三小时、十二岁以下、单纯颅脑外伤。地塞米松：课本成人四到十毫克，BC 给八毫克；儿童课本是每公斤零点二五到一毫克，BC 是每公斤零点五毫克、最多十六毫克。儿童异丙托溴铵：课本最多零点五毫克，BC 给二百五十微克。

slides.title: New for you as a PCP: watch out for
slides.body:
• Ipratropium: once only; never alone for acute bronchospasm
  • Ipratropium: caution in narrow-angle glaucoma, enlarged prostate
  • Dexamethasone is slow: never delay salbutamol or epinephrine
  • TXA: push over a full minute; faster can drop the BP
  • TXA: confirm time of injury and age before you give it
  • Never delay transport for an IV, fluids or TXA
slides.say: Here are the new traps. Ipratropium is given once only, and never on its own for an acute attack. It can raise the pressure inside the eye, so be careful with narrow-angle glaucoma, and it can hold urine in, so be careful with an enlarged prostate. Dexamethasone is slow, so it's never a reason to delay salbutamol or epinephrine. With TXA, push over a full minute, because a faster push can drop the blood pressure, and always confirm the time of injury and the age before you give it. And, as always, the IV, the fluids and the TXA happen en route. None of them is a reason to stay on scene.
slides.sayZh: 新的陷阱在这里。异丙托溴铵只给一次，急性发作时绝不能单用。它会升高眼压，闭角型青光眼要小心；它会造成尿潴留，前列腺增生要小心。地塞米松起效慢，永远不能因为它拖延沙丁胺醇或肾上腺素。TXA 要推满一分钟，推快了血压会掉；给之前一定确认受伤时间和年龄。还有，和以前一样，静脉、补液和 TXA 都在转运途中做，没有一样是留在现场的理由。

slides.title: Three things to remember
slides.body:
1. Ipratropium 500 mcg neb with salbutamol, once (child 250 mcg)
  2. Dexamethasone 8 mg (child 0.5 mg/kg, max 16), PO preferred; slow
  3. TXA 2 g IV over 1 min; not after 3 h, under 12, or isolated TBI

Next: Chapter 1: EMS Systems, Roles, and Responsibilities
slides.say: Three things to remember. One: ipratropium, five hundred micrograms by nebulizer for an adult, or two hundred fifty for a child, goes in with salbutamol, and it's given once. Two: dexamethasone, eight milligrams for an adult, or half a milligram per kilogram up to sixteen for a child, preferably by mouth. It's slow, so it supports your other treatments. Three: TXA, two grams IV push over one minute, never after three hours, never under twelve, and never for an isolated head injury. That completes the BC drug list. Next, we start the textbook with Chapter One: EMS systems, roles and responsibilities. If anything was unclear, tap Ask. See you next class.
slides.sayZh: 收尾三句话。一，异丙托溴铵成人雾化五百微克、儿童二百五十微克，和沙丁胺醇一起放，只给一次。二，地塞米松成人八毫克，儿童每公斤零点五毫克、最多十六毫克，首选口服；它起效慢，是辅助其他治疗的。三，TXA 两克静推、一分钟推完；超过三小时、十二岁以下、单纯颅脑外伤都不给。BC 考试药物到此讲完。下节课开始讲课本第一章：EMS 系统、角色与职责。有不懂的点「Ask」。下节课见。
